rationale:
The subject is `ValidationContext.read_source`. It must resolve an outline item to its graph node, read the contents, and record the observation as `read_source.inputs` describes. That cited requirement says a success records the node identity and the fingerprint of the contents. It also says failures record no successful observation, and the dependency goes stale when the node's fingerprint changes. The agent-read half of `read_source.inputs` is not part of this subject's direct method.

The test `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/project_sources.rs#mod[tests]/fn[direct_source_reads_preserve_mapping_errors_and_record_only_successful_returns]` covers each obligation:
- **Mapping failure.** Two unmappable items are tried: an unknown file (`unknown.txt`) and an unknown selector (`line[unknown]` on `source.txt`). Each returns an error containing "unsupported source item", which shows the `SourceError` converts into the domain error. Each leaves `dependencies()` empty. The test also asserts the domain's read count is 0 and `read_nodes` is empty, so the read never runs after a mapping failure.
- **Read failure.** With `fail_read` set, the error contains "prepared source read failed", so the domain's own error passes through. `dependencies()` stays empty, so failures record no observation.
- **Success.** The returned content has `format()` equal to "prepared contents", so the contents are returned. `dependencies()` is exactly `[Dependency::Node(intern_node("source-node"), returned.fingerprint())]`. That checks the mapped node identity and the content fingerprint, and that only one observation is recorded. The read count of 2 and `read_nodes` of ["source-node", "source-node"] show the item resolved to that node and the failed read was attempted but not recorded.
- **Staleness.** After `finish`, `record.is_current` is true. After the domain text changes, it is false. This covers the dependency going stale when the fingerprint changes.

`crates/trust-but-verify/tests/public_api.rs#fn[public_exports_match_the_appendix]` checks only the public export inventory. It adds nothing behavioral, and nothing more is needed from it.

The method's signature is a trivial pass-through and is not a separate behavioral obligation. Only one supported item and node are exercised. The text does not distinguish further input classes, so I do not count that as a gap. I found no unacknowledged gaps.

text: Resolve an outline item to its graph node, read the contents, and record the observation under {cite}`requirements.sdk.graph.validation-context.read_source.inputs`.
impl<D: Domain> ValidationContext<'_, D> where D::Error: From<SourceError> {
A successful source read records the mapped node's identity and the fingerprint
record when returning the contents; agent reads record when delivering them.
The dependency becomes stale when that node's fingerprint changes. The source
mapping cannot return an untracked successful read. Calling the standalone
outline parser directly records no graph dependency; a tracked node read must
enclose its use when its contents contribute to an assessment.
